FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Secure Key Solutions specializes in providing high-quality locksmith services, including residential and commercial lock installation, repair, and key duplication. Our operations are based in a secure and alarm-monitored facility located at 123 Secure Lane, Suite 100, San Diego, CA. We have been operational for over three years, ensuring stability and experience in delivering reliable locksmith services.

Our team of certified locksmiths is dedicated to customer satisfaction, emphasizing safety and professional service. We do not engage in subcontracting for locksmith services, ensuring that all work is performed in-house by our skilled employees who undergo regular training to stay updated on best practices in security and service delivery. Additionally, we are fully compliant with local regulations and maintain general liability insurance, protecting our business and our clients.

We pride ourselves on maintaining a clean business record, with no history of legal disputes or claims related to theft or vandalism, reflecting our effective risk management practices. Our commitment to security and quality positions us as a trusted locksmith provider in the community.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities that involve Business Personal Property exceeding $500,000 and confirms that it has been in continuous operation for a minimum of three years. Additionally, we have no history of equipment rental or subcontracting, and our core locksmith services are exclusively limited to residential and commercial lock installation, repair, and key duplication.
